title: Correct Seats, Overwhelmed Database
description: Conditional seat updates already prevent double booking, but 500,000 fans overwhelm the same booking rows at once. Which extra mechanism reduces contention without replacing correctness checks?

options.text: A waiting room that admits a bounded rate using signed, expiring tokens.
options.explanation: Admission controls how many buyers reach the booking service. The authoritative conditional writes still decide who owns each seat.

options.text: Remove conditions so updates spend less time checking availability.
options.explanation: That may reduce work but reintroduces overselling and violates the core invariant.

options.text: Allow unlimited optimistic retries from all rejected buyers.
options.explanation: High-conflict retries amplify load on the same hot rows.

options.text: Hold every row lock while buyers enter payment details.
options.explanation: Long human waits would consume connections and locks; model holds as expiring data instead.
